scope: Preserve milestone move and project assignment intent through conflicts and uncertain writes, with explicit reviewed recovery.

backend.qualification: Unchanged frozen team-query backend already qualified with the palette candidate; no new backend build, migration, schema, API or generated-contract change.

behavior: A failed 412 or uncertain PUT retains the original relative milestone move or issue/milestone selection. Authorized reads prepare a review; only an explicit action sends another mutation with the reviewed current project validator.

Milestone recovery reads the full authorized project and at most five 100-row pages. Every page must match the full project ETag and correct workspace/team/project. Final metadata must match the starting metadata validator. Missing anchors, duplicate IDs, incomplete/repeated cursors and the 500-row budget fail closed.
Rebasing removes only the moved milestone and places it immediately before/after its retained anchor in the current complete order. Concurrently added milestones remain in the reviewed proposal.

Assignment recovery exhausts at most ten 100-row pages within a shared 10-second read deadline. Stable project metadata and stable live expected-team issue reads bracket the scan; positive/absent membership cannot come from a partial page or archived/deleted/moved issue. Current and desired milestone labels are freshly authorized and scoped.

Current-state equivalence may confirm the desired position or assignment only. It never identifies the original request or actor, and does not trigger a replay. Unresolved reads preserve intent and disable mutation until another explicit successful review.

Authority denial removes cached component labels and pending intent. Account/session/workspace/team/project boundaries destroy old state and abort requests. Pending review/write participates in the existing unsaved-navigation guard.

Completing a review restores meaningful focus to the moved milestone control or the project issues section when the origin row is removed or paginated away. Retained add-issue modal drafts keep their own focus on discard.

actual_scenarios: Real competing milestone creation produces 412. Explicit reviewed retry preserves the new milestone. A later actual committed PUT is relayed as client response loss; complete authorized order readback and reload confirm desired position without replay or actor acknowledgment. Both completion paths restore focus.

A real 102-issue project places the target after the first 100. A concurrent metadata update produces assignment 412; two complete pages preserve the desired milestone choice for explicit retry. A later actual committed removal is relayed as response loss; exhausted 100+1 pages and stable live issue/metadata reads confirm current absence without replay. Reload preserves version and unchanged issue data. Actual private-team revocation returns 404 and removes cached project/issue labels.
